description: Publish an OpenTrain draft job live on the marketplace. Runs the same validation + moderation pipeline as the in-app publish flow and is subject to per-account daily publish limits. Requires jobs:write scope and the public_api_job_publishing feature (check the job-drafts capabilities endpoint or a 403 response). Returns the live job URL.

jobId.description: Existing unpublished OpenTrain draft job id to publish live.

name: opentrain_publish_job
